scope: larger synthetic development comparison, not sealed test or literature reproduction
selection: sample twenty complete shared nuisance-condition groups at each SNR from train; retain all twelve classes of each group; noise SNR undefined, paired group retained
validation: existing full validation split, 1080 examples, previously used for development; check hash via pinned metadata and group/source disjointness
test_policy: test.npz is not opened; existing test has already been inspected in earlier work, so no claim of a sealed final test
optimizer: fresh Adam lr0.0001 eps1e-8, no scheduler/clipping/augmentation
checkpoint_rule: strictly minimum mean validation cross entropy, evaluated after each epoch; ties keep earliest; always run fixed100 epochs, no early stopping
primary: paired validation loss and macro-F1 of selected checkpoints, separately for each seed; accuracy/class recalls secondary
decision: advance candidate only if gain2 has strictly smaller selected-checkpoint validation loss and higher macro-F1 in both seeds; otherwise mixed, do not discard seeds or retune using test
failure: stop on nonfinite loss/gradients, preserve partial outputs; no automatic retry/resume
limits: larger subset and low SNR regime differ from preceding120-example memorization check; no direct score comparison
validation reused for selection, results are development estimates
same synthetic generators, not real RF or drone protocol accuracy
historical FP32 gate unchanged; explicit experimental port adaptation
